reviews.text: They always let me drop in for a nail trim and finish it so fast with a reasonable price. My dog has lots of anxiety especially towards men and they treat him really well.

My Corgi mix was in desperate need of springtime haircut. Lucas (owner) knew exactly what to do with a double coat dog. He also has a Corgi. My dog came out looking like a great spa day. We're very happy!

my dog has refused to eat since receiving his grooming, having nightmares and after the shave i found blood around a mole and his ankles on his back foot. he looks great but i’m unsure what he went though there to cause this trauma.
I always take my dog here - great staff and great cut for my dog!
The most best dig grooming place since I got my dog . We have not so good experiences in the other places , but thanks to Okie for providing the best services to our family.
took my 11 month old maltipoo puppy for a haircut and she came back cuter than ever! she had some mats and her fur was quite long, but they did an excellent job and treated her very well:)
Great experience here! Very nice and friendly staff and they groomed our corgi so well! The prices are reasonable too!
Our dog Pippa absolutely loves going to get groomed with Lukas and his team!!  They are so gentle and kind and she always looks and smells fabulous afterwards!
Okie Doggie always takes good care of my pup. Lucas is a skilled and reliable groomer that I can trust.
Amazing service and my dog Mia looks so cute! Customer service is amazing, they always greet me with a smile and end the result is always amazing. Thank you OKIE DOKIE!🐾💕🐾💕 …

Great job and nice people there. We go every 5 weeks!

Update - April 11 2025 - we took our 17 YO dog in  yesterday and he was treated as being nothing short of a king. They gave him the utmost of care and attention. He is literally 10 times happier today than yesterday and is walking easier and much more alert. As part of him bath, blow-dry and triming, they found his toe nails were too long and causing him issues. We are SO happy we took him in

Lucas and team, thank you so much for an outstanding grooming for my Shih Tzu Cookie. She looks very pretty. I get stopped on the road all the time by people who are so complimentary. She looks very sweet.

Excellent service! They are always so kind and welcoming to us and do a fantastic job. My morkie is terrefied of getting groomed but they always do a great job of calming him down and he comes out looking like a beauty!

Got my 15yr old Havanese groomed here for the first time and they did such a wonderful job. He looked so adorable and just like a puppy again. I truly felt like they cared about my dog and put the effort into making him comfortable and happy.

Will definitely be returning!
